Terms.title: Privacy Policy & Legal Terms
Terms.intro: In compliance with Chilean Law No. 19.628 and the GDPR (EU 2016/679), Sumadots defines the data processing and privacy terms to protect the information of its users and business partners.
Terms.sec1Content: The data controller is Suma Dots SpA. We collect corporate information (Identity, Contact, Technical Data) exclusively for managing business relationships, billing, and optimizing automation services.
Terms.sec2Content: Processing is based on your consent and service execution. We do not sell your data. We share strictly necessary information with technology infrastructure providers (hosting, databases, security) acting as 'Data Processors' under enterprise-grade security standards. The current list of providers is available upon request.
Terms.sec3Content: Under current law, you have the right to Access, Rectification, Erasure, Opposition, Portability, and Restriction of processing. You may exercise these rights free of charge by contacting legal@sumadots.com.
Terms.sec4Content: All technical proposals, software architectures, and methodologies delivered by Sumadots are protected intellectual property. An implicit Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) applies to sensitive information shared during diagnostic stages.
Terms.sec5Content: We implement SSL/TLS encryption and perimeter security protocols. Data will be retained for the duration of the business relationship or as required to comply with legal tax obligations.
Terms.sec6Content: This site uses technical cookies for operation. For any legal disputes, the parties submit to the Ordinary Courts of Justice of Santiago, Chile.
Terms.footerNote: To exercise your rights or DPO inquiries: legal@sumadots.com

q1.question: Are you a Software Factory? Do you build apps?
q1.answer: The short answer is yes, but our approach is different. We don't just deliver code; we aim to **generate value over time**. If your growth requires an app, we develop it with an **incremental mindset (80/20)**: prioritizing the 20% of development that yields 80% of the impact.

q2.question: I don't have a tech team, can I work with you?
q2.answer: Absolutely. We become your **Expert Partner** and act as the technical team your company needs. We don't just handle the implementation; we **guide the strategic alignment with technology** to ensure every development directly drives your business vision.

q3.question: How long does implementation take?
q3.answer: Unlike the 6-18 months it takes to build an in-house team, we work with **ready-to-deploy systems**. Generally, we get initial solutions up and running within **6 to 12 weeks**.

q4.question: Are costs fixed or variable?
q4.answer: We work with a **fixed investment and no surprises**. Unlike hiring staff where costs can skyrocket, with Sumadots you know exactly how much you'll invest from day one to **scale your operation**.

q5.question: Will you understand my business or just write code?
q5.answer: That is our main differentiator. We bridge **Strategy and Technology**. Our strategic business associate ensures the technical architecture aligns with your vision, guaranteeing **real adoption and ROI**.
